# 2018 Vuelta a Castilla y León

The Vuelta a Castilla y León is a professional road cycling stage race held in the Castilla y León region of Spain. Here is what I know about the 2018 edition:

## General Information

- The race was a multi-stage event typically held in the spring as part of the European cycling calendar.
- It was part of the UCI Europe Tour, generally classified as a 2.1 category event (though its classification has varied over the years).

## Key Details

The 2018 edition was notable because the race had gone through some disruptions in its history. The Vuelta a Castilla y León had been suspended or not held in certain years due to organizational and financial difficulties. By 2018, the race's status was uncertain, and I believe the race may not have actually taken place that year, as it had been off the calendar for several consecutive editions.

The last consistently held editions were in the early-to-mid 2010s, with the race facing cancellations afterward.

## Historical Context

Historically, the race attracted notable winners including riders like Alejandro Valverde, Alberto Contador, and other prominent Spanish and international cyclists.
